```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(here)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
#Reading data into R
data_path_cafe <- here::here("data", "cafe.csv")
data_path_cafe_index <- here::here("data", "cappuccino_index.csv")
cafe <- read_csv(data_path_cafe)
cappuccino_index <- read_csv(data_path_cafe_index)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
#Looking at the data to see what we have
glimpse(cafe)
glimpse(cappuccino_index)
head(cafe)
```
```{r}
#| include: false
#Found data has 8 entries under china and 7 of them are hong kong, in HKD currency
#Decided to scrap China and keep hong kong separately as differences are large and not 
#representative for China (way too high price for cappuccino) 
cafe <- cafe |>
  filter(!(country == "China" & city == "Shenzhen")) |>
  mutate(country = if_else(country == "China", "Hong Kong", country))

#check
cafe |> filter(country == "Hong Kong") |> count(city, original_currency)

avg_per_country <- cafe |>
      group_by(country) |>
      summarize(total_cafe_visits = n(),
                mean_cafe_price_gbp = mean(price_gbp, na.rm = TRUE),
                mean_hourly_wage_gbp = mean(hourly_wage_gbp, na.rm = TRUE),
                total_urban = sum(urban, na.rm = TRUE),
                total_suburban = sum(suburban, na.rm = TRUE),
                total_rural = sum(rural, na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = "drop")
head(avg_per_country)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
#Filter which countries to exclude because of too little visits
avg_per_country_sorted_desc <- avg_per_country |> arrange(desc(total_cafe_visits))
#head(avg_per_country_sorted_desc)
#avg_per_country |> filter(total_cafe_visits >= 5) |> nrow()
#avg_per_country |> filter(total_cafe_visits >= 7) |> nrow()
min_visits = 7
avg_per_country_filtered <- avg_per_country |>
                        filter(total_cafe_visits >= min_visits)
#glimpse(avg_per_country_filtered)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
labeled <- avg_per_country_filtered |>
  filter(rank(-mean_cafe_price_gbp) <= 5 | rank(-mean_hourly_wage_gbp) <= 3)

p_scatter <- ggplot(avg_per_country_filtered,
                    aes(x = mean_hourly_wage_gbp,
                        y = mean_cafe_price_gbp)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = total_cafe_visits), alpha = 0.6, colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = labeled, aes(label = country),
            size = 2, vjust = -1, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Number of\nobservations") +
    labs(title = "Do higher wages mean\npricier cappuccinos?",
       x = "Mean hourly wage (GBP)",
       y = "Mean cappuccino price (GBP)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"))

p_scatter
```
```{r}
#| include: false
cafe |> count(urban, suburban, rural)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
# 1) priprava podatkov: prag držav, nato ena oznaka na vrstico
cafe_prag <- cafe |>
             filter(country %in% avg_per_country_filtered$country)

cafe_area <- cafe_prag |>
  filter(urban + suburban + rural == 1) |>   # izloči vrstice z več oznakami
  mutate(area_type = case_when(urban    ~ "Urban",
                               suburban ~ "Suburban",
                               rural    ~ "Rural"),
         area_type = factor(area_type, levels = c("Urban", "Suburban", "Rural")))

n_excluded <- nrow(cafe_prag) - nrow(cafe_area)

# 2) oznake panelov s številom vnosov
n_lab <- cafe_area |> count(area_type)
panel_labels <- setNames(paste0(n_lab$area_type, " (n = ", n_lab$n, ")"),
                         n_lab$area_type)

# 3) histogram z facetami
p_hist <- ggplot(cafe_area, aes(x = price_gbp, y = after_stat(density))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", colour = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ area_type, nrow = 1, labeller = labeller(area_type = panel_labels)) +
  labs(title = "Cappuccino price distribution by area type",
       x = "Cappuccino price (GBP)",
       y = "Density",
       caption = paste0(n_excluded, " observations with more than one area label excluded.")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

p_hist
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)

# podgraf 2: top 10 držav po indeksu (prag n >= min_visits)
p_col <- cappuccino_index |>
  filter(n >= min_visits) |>
  slice_max(index, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = index, y = reorder(country, index))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = index_as_time), hjust = -0.15, size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.35))) +
  labs(title = "Least affordable cappuccinos",
       x = "Minutes of work per cappuccino\n(bar labels: min:sec)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))

final_plot <- ((p_scatter + labs(caption = NULL)) | p_col) /
  (p_hist + labs(caption = NULL)) +
  plot_annotation(
  title = "Cappuccino prices, wages and affordability across countries",
  caption = paste0("Source: TidyTuesday 2026-09-08. Countries with fewer than ", min_visits,
                   " observations excluded (",
                   nrow(avg_per_country) - nrow(avg_per_country_filtered), " of ",
                   nrow(avg_per_country), ").\nPanel C: ", n_excluded,
                   " observations with more than one area label excluded.",
                   "\nMainland China (Shenzhen, 1 observation) excluded; remaining 'China' entries",
                   " (all Hong Kong) relabelled 'Hong Kong'. Panel B uses the original index table."),
  tag_levels = "A",
  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
                plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 6.5),
                plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8),
                plot.tag = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
                plot.tag.position = c(0, 1))
)

final_plot

```
